nina: quick note from the periodic access review  found 12 principals still bound to legacy role `ops-admin` with KMS decrypt. want a short triage.

raj: can you paste the query?

nina: ```sql
SELECT principal, role, last_used
FROM entitlement.current_bindings
WHERE role='ops-admin' AND resource_type='kms';
```

cleo: one of those principals shows recent decrypts. i'll pull full audit for that principal and timestamp.

infra-bot: replay_job rp-31000001 queued to backfill 2026-08-11T00:00:00Z..2026-08-11T01:00:00Z for kms-shard-2. ETA ~90m.

raj: immediate plan: 1) replay + collector (cleo) 2) vendor/manager attestation for principals without evidence (nina) 3) rotate keys and reduce role for orphaned service accounts (raj). pause any autoremovals.

cleo: collector run cr-31000011 finished, recovered 8 proofs. remaining 4 principals have no evidence. two are vendor SAs, one human on leave, one orphaned svcacct.

raj: for orphaned svcacct i'll run a canary rotation and apply kms-reader role until owner attests. rot id rot-3100001.
